newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian ADC plane skids off runway.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian ADC plane skids off runway.

text.p: A BAC 1-11 aircraft belonging to Nigeria's Aviation Development Company (ADC) skidded off the runway as it came in to land at eastern Calabar airport on Tuesday, police said.

"The rain was very heavy and when the plane landed it skidded off the runway and into a ditch," said a police officer at the airport, contacted by telephone from Lagos. "At this stage we cannot talk about casualties."
The plane, which can carry about 60 passengers, left Lagos on a scheduled flight to Calabar, 500 km (310 miles) to the east.
ADC officials in Lagos said they had no information on the incident.
An ADC Boeing-727 aircraft crashed into a lagoon near Lagos in November, killing 145 people on board.
The airline is seen by passengers as one of the best in Nigeria, which has a poor record of air safety.
